verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's core product turns a team's own code and PR data into AI insights inside the product. It documents AI reviews with actionable, one-click-applicable suggestions, auto-generated PR summaries and walkthroughs, CI failure analysis with suggested fixes, Triage prioritization by value and risk, and natural-language chat and Slack investigation across the codebase, Sentry and Jira. Community users confirm the reviews catch real bugs, though one reports verbosity and false positives. missing for 10: the analytics dashboard is not described as producing AI-generated insights (only metrics), and independent corroboration of suggestion quality is mixed.
